text:
Ravi (PM): Quick callout 1 min1 we need to agree on scope for the Console cost/observability pilot. Customers ask for: per-route chargeback CSVs, trace links from cost rows, and an error fingerprint view. We only have 2 engineers partial this quarter.

Nora (Eng-Platform): From infra POV: cheapest win is aggregated exports (CSV) and route->sampled-trace link. Exact per-invocation attribution touches billing and runtime. Estimate: 2 sprints for CSV+links, 4+ sprints for exact.

Diego (Eng-ML): We can produce an estimator that uses token-count heuristics + model profile. In our sandbox it hits ~90% correlation. Recommend exposing a confidence_pct with every aggregate row.

Hannah (Support): Field feedback: finance teams want auditability. They'll accept "ESTIMATED" clearly labelled for hosted preview, but for Dedicated customers they expect audited numbers. Also need an error-fingerprint list that shows sample traces for audits.

Ravi (PM): Proposed split: Preview (hosted) = aggregated, estimated CSV + sampled trace links + fingerprints. GA (dedicated/private) = exact per-invocation attribution, reconciliation job, exportable audited CSV. Can Eng live with that?

Nora (Eng-Platform): Acceptable if we add model-version and batch-mode tags to metrics so we can track estimator drift. Also need a policy for sampling traces (error-heavy + tail-cost).

Diego (Eng-ML): I'll provide a sampling config: higher percent for errors and high-est-cost outliers. Also will emit est_cost and confidence_pct in metrics.

Hannah (Support): I'll line up two pilot customers who consent to "Preview: estimated" labeling and help validate samples.

sales-bot: Created ticket COSTS-302: "pilot: cost visibility preview" assigned to eng-platform, eng-ml. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/COSTS-302

Ravi (PM): Acceptance criteria for Preview:
- UI: Finance exports page with route selector, time-range, export button.
- CSV: columns [route, start_ts, end_ts, tokens_est, est_cost, confidence_pct, note="ESTIMATED"].
- Link: clicking export row shows sampled traces (min 3 examples if available).
- Errors: fingerprint table with count + sample trace id.
- Docs: migration playbook to Dedicated for audited numbers.

Nora (Eng-Platform): Risks: quantization/quant changes affect estimator. We'll include model-tagging and nightly recalibration checks.

Diego (Eng-ML): Next steps: spike to validate estimator correlation across current models (due Wed). I'll post results.

Hannah (Support): I'll coordinate pilots and draft customer-facing language.

Ravi (PM): Great. We'll aim to ship preview to pilots and then widen. :thumbsup:
